config.description: A deliberately DIVERSE ensemble member, not a candidate to ship alone. v028's exact architecture, recipe, distill_weight 1.0 and teacher, with one change to the objective: loss.pool global -> per_sequence. Under global pooling every row of every lane feeds ONE correlation, which is what the live metric does. Under per-sequence pooling each lane gets its own correlation and they are averaged, so a per-lane level offset is washed out instead of being free.
config.hypothesis: This is the CORRECTED retest of an idea already refuted once. dozken measured +0.0056 global WP at P(>0)=1.000 from ensembling two models trained with different LOSSES, and stated that same-loss pairs add nothing. We tried it with v028 + v029 and got -0.000174, inside the noise floor. The diagnosis was that the members were not actually diverse: v029 differs from v028 only by gamma=2.0 tail-weighting, which was itself already a measured null (+0.000002), and a knob that provably does nothing cannot create diversity. So the lesson was applied rather than the result forgotten. v033 is built to diverge: global and per-sequence pooling genuinely disagree, and the disagreement is measured rather than assumed. Injecting per-lane level offsets spread -3..3 into a synthetic batch costs the global loss 0.276 and the per-sequence loss 0.069, a 4x difference, while a single shared offset of +3 costs both 0.195 identically -- which is correct, because a shared bias is not re-centreable. That is the diversity dozken's pair had and ours did not. Prediction: v033 alone scores BELOW v028, because per-sequence pooling is the objective the metric abandoned on 2026-09-15. dozken measured exactly this inversion: his reset4k (per-sequence loss) 0.6598 -> 0.6823 while seq_5ep went 0.6671 -> 0.6704, and he notes a pure per-sequence offset cost the old loss +0.0000 and the new one +0.0721. A member that is individually worse and differently wrong is precisely what an ensemble wants, and this run is only useful if its score is within a few sigma of v028's. If it lands far below, the diversity is real but too expensive and this line closes.
config.change_vs_parent: loss.pool global -> per_sequence only. The aux MSE and distillation terms are shared code paths and unchanged, and the reporting metric stays global, so v033 is scored on exactly the same rows and metric as every other run in the table. Verified pool=global reproduces v028's loss bit-identically (diff 0.00e+00), so the option itself introduces no drift.
